macro_bullets: Oil holds near six-month highs as escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure and airports stoke supply fears, with Brent topping $116.
Israel holds its first election since October 7, with markets eyeing potential upside in a Netanyahu defeat and renewed Iran-war risk.

internals_narrative: Energy led sharply (+2.6%) with oilfield-services and E&P names like SLB (+7.1%), HAL (+5.2%), DVN (+4.5%) and BKR (+4.2%) topping gainers as crude rallied, while Communication Services (-2.5%) lagged on a telecom rout led by T (-8.0%) and TMUS (-7.7%) on SpaceX cell-tower fears; Financials (-1.4%) and Consumer Staples/Discretionary (~-2%) were also weak.
